description: Use for: interacting with the page — click, fill, type, select, submit, press. Returns the resulting page title, URL and text so you can verify the action landed. Don't use when: the target element is not on the current page — navigate or snapshot first. This tool can change remote state (it can submit forms). Paid: $0.01 per call via x402 (Base USDC, Solana USDC, or XRPL XRP).

action.description: The interaction to perform on the target element.

selector.description: CSS selector of the target element.

session_id.description: Session ID. Reuse the same ID to keep cookies, login state and page position across calls; a new ID starts a fresh browser.

value.description: Value for fill/type/select, or key name for press (default Enter).

name: browser_act
title: Act on the current page
